For a first-timer, hamsters are described as one of the best beginner pets because they’re gentle and easy to care for. Just be sure to:

Give them a spacious cage
Add toys like tunnels and exercise balls
House only same-gender hamsters together to avoid surprise litters, and keep Syrian hamsters solo as they’re territorial.
